 Game Coverage: Listen Live Stats No. 4 UConn Competes at No. 7 Louisville Sunday
 11/14/2026 4:19:00 PM | Women's Basketball
 Listen Live Stats Game Notes Share: STORRS, Conn. – The No. 4 UConn women's basketball team (3-1) plays at No. 7 Louisville (5-0) Sunday at 5:30 p.m. in the KFC Yum! Center. The game will air on ESPN and the UConn Sports Network from Learfield (FOX Sports 97.9).
 The Cardinals are the fourth straight ranked opponents for the Huskies. Louisville is the first of three ACC teams UConn will fac in the regular season.
 Junior Sarah Strong scored 20 of her 25 points in the second half to lead UConn past No. 17 Ohio State, 87-55, on Thursday. Strong went 7-for-8 from three-point range vs. the Buckeyes and added nine rebounds and five assists.
  Freshman Olivia Vukosa had her best game as a Husky, notching 12 rebounds, eight points, six assists and two blocks.
 UConn is 21-3 all-time vs. Louisville. The teams last played on Nov. 4, 2025, in the Armed Forces Classic. Sarah Strong led the Huskies with 21 points, 10 rebounds and five assists in the game. This is UConn's first game at Louisville since 2019.
 Louisville moved to 5-0 with a 94-73 win over Ball State on Thursday. This season, Tajianna Roberts leads the Cardinals with 16.4 points per game. Head coach Jeff Walz is in his 20th season at Louisville.
 UConn next plays at home on Friday, Nov. 20, for the team's BIG EAST opener vs. Seton Hall. Fans are encouraged to wear BLUE for the Huskies' Bleed Blue game.
